availability_contract.feature_error: raise; not a success or hardware fault diagnosis
availability_contract.missing: q_eeg=0; eeg_available=False; eeg_probs=[.2]*5; old probabilities discarded
availability_contract.partial_flat_or_low_q: remains candidate available; final E4 usability policy not selected

fit_policy.preprocessing: none; feature ratios are not restandardized
fit_policy.weights: equal subject -> severity -> family -> rows, calculated in fit subset

detector.algorithm: PyPREP NoisyChannels detection-only; explicit method subset

hold.aggregation: mean over 30 channels of qualifying samples/2500
hold.rule: exact consecutive repeated values, run length>=10 samples

spectral.zero_denominator: ratio=0, paired with flat/hold flags; not automatically healthy

input_contract.waveform_stage: released EAV source window BEFORE E4 500->200 resampling and Train standardization

limitations: Quality targets are engineering proxies, not MOS/neural SNR/emotion correctness or fusion weights.
Reference means no extra corruption, not independently certified clean.
Feature selection followed EQ1 exploration; LOSO is internal development validation only.
Same severity names across families are not a verified equal-harm scale.
Coordinate monotonicity is a modelling constraint, not a universal physiology rule.
Frequency ratios are coupled and may change in opposing directions under degradation.
Synthetic flat/hold fingerprints do not establish sensitivity to all real hardware faults.
Proxy q is clipped to [severe,clean] on available inputs; it does not extrapolate towards zero.
Unit conversion is inherited as recorded; calibration does not independently confirm it.
Runtime must reproduce 30-channel/500Hz/5s feature semantics and verified acquisition scaling.
A 5s q is not an automatically validated 20s trial quality policy.
No E4/fusion forward, actual weight-zero verification, hardware recovery, or Test evaluation here.

expected_source_detector.algorithm: PyPREP NoisyChannels detection-only; explicit method subset
